# Radoslav Radev Advises Planche And Front Lever Attempts One Two Times Per Week On Free Days

Radoslav Radev advises doing planche and front lever attempts one two times per week on the days you can. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 05:50]

## Details

- He says not every day works, but on the days you can during the week his advice is to do it one or two times per week. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 05:50]
- He says it is good if you can do it every day, for example if you work in IT from a home office. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 06:00]
- In one workout he says to do one attempt of planche and one attempt of front lever. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 06:06]

## Evidence

- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 05:50 (Radoslav Radev): "Yes, not every day you can do that, but on the days that you can do it during the week, my advice for you is to do it one two times per week"
- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 06:00 (Radoslav Radev): "it's good if you can do it every day if you work i.t if your home office"
- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 06:06 (Radoslav Radev): "do it plunge [planche] in front lever in one workout one attempt of plunge [planche] one attempt of front lever"
